name: event_id
description: UUID assigned when the event is written to Postgres's warehouse_outbox. The *_dedup views keep one row per event_id.

name: event_ts
description: When the event happened in the control plane (UTC). Day partitions use this column.

name: eval_run_id
description: One evaluation run: a CI job or one online-eval batch.

name: suite
description: golden, safety, judge, calibration or online.

name: case_version
description: Version of the case, so changed cases are not compared with old results.

name: trial
description: Trial number, 1 to k (k = 3 for nondeterministic cases).

name: prompt_version
description: Hash of the agent's prompts at evaluation time.

name: git_ref
description: Branch or PR ref evaluated (CI runs).

name: passed
description: Whether every behavioral assertion for the case passed.

name: failure_reason
description: First failed assertion, when passed is false.

name: judge_scores
description: Rubric scores from the LLM judge, keyed by rubric dimension (1-5).
